title: Share/Repost Modal
content: Build share/repost modal. Options: "Repost" (share to feed instantly), "Quote" (add comment before sharing), "Copy Link" (with success toast), "Share via..." (Twitter, Facebook, email). Post preview: show original post being shared. Quote mode: textarea for adding comment. Direct message: share to specific users via DM.

variants.simple: Create share modal with repost, quote, and share options.
variants.detailed: Build share/repost modal. Options: "Repost" (share to feed instantly), "Quote" (add comment before sharing), "Copy Link" (with success toast), "Share via..." (Twitter, Facebook, email). Post preview: show original post being shared. Quote mode: textarea for adding comment. Direct message: share to specific users via DM.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive share/repost modal with multiple sharing options. Trigger: share button (Share2 or repeat icon) on posts opens modal. Modal structure: centered, max-w-md, bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl. Header: "Share" title, close X button. Post preview: compact preview of post being shared (author avatar+name, truncated content, media thumbnail if applicable) in bordered container. Sharing options as list: Repost/Reblog: Share2 icon, "Repost", "Share to your profile instantly", one-click action with confirmation toast, adds to your feed with "Reposted by [you]" attribution. Quote Post: MessageSquare icon, "Quote", "Add your thoughts", click expands to quote mode. Send via Message: Send icon, "Send in message", "Share privately with someone", opens user selector for DM. Copy Link: Link icon, "Copy link", click copies URL to clipboard, button changes to "Copied!" with Check icon briefly. External share options: Twitter/X icon, "Share to Twitter" opens Twitter intent URL, Facebook, LinkedIn, Email (mailto: with subject and body). Quote mode expansion: when Quote selected, reveal textarea (placeholder "Add a comment..."), character counter, original post preview below, "Share" primary button. Send via message flow: search/select recipients from followers, recent conversations, preview of message with post attachment, send button. Share URL: generate clean shareable URL, shortened if service available. Analytics tracking: track which share method used for engagement metrics. Embed code: for supported platforms, "Embed" option with copyable HTML code. QR code: optional QR code generation for easy mobile sharing. Schedule: option to schedule repost for later. Audience selector: if applicable, choose who sees the repost (public, followers, close friends). Mobile: bottom sheet that slides up, full-width buttons, larger touch targets. Accessibility: modal traps focus, buttons labeled clearly, share status announced.

author: Ersin KOÇ
